braid_equivalent — DRIVE braidpath op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.braid_equivalent(word_a, word_b, n_strands, method='dynnikov') (to call the implementation directly, import braidpath; braidpath.braid_equivalent(word_a, word_b, n_strands, method='dynnikov'); from the registry, opsdrive.get("braid_equivalent"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Whether two braid words represent the same braid (are related by the relations alone).

method: "dynnikov" (compare coordinates, fast) / "handle" (handle-reduce a b⁻¹ and check whether it is empty) / "artin" (compare the free-group images) / "all" (compute all three; RuntimeError if they disagree —— an implementation check).

Returns: dict equal, method, key_a / key_b (Dynnikov keys), reduced_quotient (reduction of a b⁻¹, for handle / all).

Empty input (word_a with 0 elements) returns the answer of the comparison with the trivial braid (reason: the empty word is the identity, a valid braid).
